input.command:
cat > /tmp/opencode/an.py <<'EOF'
import re, json
from collections import Counter
err=0; codes=Counter(); lat=[]; users=set(); fatal=None
for line in open('/tmp/opencode/bench/log-analysis-baseline/server.log'):
    line=line.rstrip('\n')
    if not line: continue
    ts,level,rest=line.split(' ',2)
    if level=='ERROR':
        err+=1
        m=re.search(r'code=(\S+)',rest)
        if m: codes[m.group(1)]+=1
    if 'route=/api/checkout' in rest:
        m=re.search(r'latency=(\d+)ms',rest)
        if m: lat.append(int(m.group(1)))
    if 'timeout' in rest.lower().split('msg=',1)[-1]:
        m=re.search(r'user=(\S+)',rest)
        if m: users.add(m.group(1))
    if level=='FATAL' and fatal is None: fatal=ts
ans={'error_count':err,'top_error_code':codes.most_common(1)[0][0],
     'checkout_mean_latency_ms':round(sum(lat)/len(lat)),
     'timeout_unique_users':len(users),'first_fatal_ts':fatal}
print(sum(lat)/len(lat), len(lat), codes.most_common(5))
json.dump(ans,open('/tmp/opencode/bench/log-analysis-baseline/answers.json','w'),indent=2)
print(ans)
EOF
python3 /tmp/opencode/an.py; cat /tmp/opencode/bench/log-analysis-baseline/answers.json
